question: What is the median of the average monthly projected sales in USD for France in 2021, calculated by using the monthly sales data from 2019 and 2020 (filtered by promo_total_id=1 and channel_total_id=1), applying the growth rate from 2019 to 2020 to project 2021, converting to USD based on the currency table, and then determining the monthly averages before finding their median?

WITH filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        s.time_id,
        t.calendar_year,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        cur.to_us as conversion_rate,
        s.amount_sold
    FROM sales s
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN countries co ON co.country_name = 'France'
    JOIN customers c ON c.country_id = co.country_id AND c.cust_valid = 'I'
    JOIN promotions p ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id AND p.promo_total_id = 1
    JOIN channels ch ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
    LEFT JOIN currency cur ON co.country_name = cur.country 
        AND t.calendar_year = cur.year
        AND t.calendar_month_number = cur.month
    WHERE t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
),
monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        calendar_month_number,
        SUM(amount_sold * conversion_rate) as monthly_total_usd
    FROM filtered_sales
    GROUP BY calendar_year, calendar_month_number
),
monthly_averages_2019 AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_month_number,
        AVG(monthly_total_usd) as avg_2019
    FROM monthly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2019
    GROUP BY calendar_month_number
),
monthly_averages_2020 AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_month_number,
        AVG(monthly_total_usd) as avg_2020
    FROM monthly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020
    GROUP BY calendar_month_number
),
growth_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        ma2019.calendar_month_number,
        ((ma2020.avg_2020 - ma2019.avg_2019) / NULLIF(ma2019.avg_2019, 0)) as growth_rate
    FROM monthly_averages_2019 ma2019
    JOIN monthly_averages_2020 ma2020 ON ma2019.calendar_month_number = ma2020.calendar_month_number
),
projected_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        gr.calendar_month_number,
        ma2020.avg_2020 * (1 + gr.growth_rate) as projected_monthly_sales_usd
    FROM growth_rates gr
    JOIN monthly_averages_2020 ma2020 ON gr.calendar_month_number = ma2020.calendar_month_number
)
SELECT MEDIAN(projected_monthly_sales_usd) as median_monthly_sales_usd FROM projected_2021;
